fusions.name: Borrowed Voice
fusions.desc: Throws a mimicked cry into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 30% chance of leaving it [Stalled] for 4 seconds, so its abilities come back slower.

fusions.name: Pilfering Pass
fusions.desc: A strike from the flank that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lost Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and enemies notice you far later. You move 20% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Opening Gambit
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
